title: Optimizer-state Mirror superposition across tasks
hypothesis: A shared learned rank-4 state basis plus per-task Mirror coordinates reconstructs task-specific Adam state well enough that five-step continuation NRMSE is within 1.10x of exact Adam state, while reducing serialized task payload bytes versus independent state and matching rank-4 PCA control.
physical_object: one shared 16D linear model plus shared optimizer-state basis
mirror_coordinate: 4D task code addresses concatenated Adam first/second moment state
controls: learned shared basis plus 4D Mirror state code

task.type: 16D linear regression with four latent task factors

paid_objects: Adam m and v or shared state basis and task code

success_gate: Every fresh world: Mirror continuation NRMSE <=1.10x exact Adam state; actual N=20 bytes lower than independent state; Mirror quality and bytes within 5% of rank-4 PCA control.
failure_gate: Any quality/byte gate miss, or PCA/PSP matches Mirror at equal or fewer bytes.
boundaries: Synthetic task-state compression mechanism test only.
Optimizer state is a target for compression only if serialized m/v bytes exceed task routing metadata.
No natural optimizer-state or model-capacity claim.
